biography.text: Born in 1962 in Neptune, New Jersey. Wigenton received a B.A. from Norfolk State University (1984) and a J.D. from William & Mary Law School (1987). She clerked for New Jersey Superior Court Judge Lawrence M. Lawson, practiced in Middletown, and served as a District of New Jersey magistrate judge from 2000 to 2006. President George W. Bush appointed her.
